note: Generated from fleet/fleet_initial.csv and data/<Country>.csv. Do not hand-edit. attrition.rate = median net exit share of the passenger-car stock per year (scrappage + exports - used imports); inflow_mix = split of the non-plug-in side of the last 12 months of registrations; reg_by_year = yearly registrations used as the age profile of the stock (COMBUSTION = TOTAL - BEV - PHEV - HEV, extended backwards with all new cars from fleet/registrations_history.csv); age_bands = observed shares of the stock under 5 / 5-10 / 10-20 / over 20 years (fleet/fleet_age.csv); mileage = km per car of the year-end stock (fleet/mileage.csv totals divided by the stock).
